title: Propose the preset the current stage of work needs, one preset at a time

facts.note: Needs an observer that knows the work has entered RED (first acceptance test being written) while profiles: still holds only the planning preset.
Locates the configuration file; reading its profiles: membership (or absence of the list) is part of the config-vs-stage observer below.

values: stage preset not in profiles: list
facts.note: Comparing active profiles against the preset for the current stage requires a config-vs-stage observer.
Which work the user is doing cannot be validated from the repository; the agent judges it and confirms with the user.

fires: RED starts while only planner is listed in profiles:
No profiles: list is set in atdd-bun.yaml and work begins
The user starts instrumenting and telemetry is not yet in profiles:
The user starts durable multi-agent coordination, the Flow companion is installed locally, and flow is not in profiles:
doesNotFire: The preset for the current stage is already contained in profiles:
The user only runs a profile by name to preview what it would report
Coordination work in a repository without the locally installed Flow companion (flow is not proposed)

given: The work reached a stage whose preset is not in profiles: of atdd-bun.yaml (e.g. RED starts with only planner on, or no profiles: list is set).
then: Ask the user what they want to do (planning, building, instrumenting or coordinating) and recommend the matching preset as an addition to the current list.
prefer: After the user decides, write exactly the list they chose to profiles: in atdd-bun.yaml.
Say presets are adopted step by step, each the set most consistent with that work, so nothing needs activating all at once.
Planning: planner (+ docs when the repository keeps documentation under docs/); planner alone parses, validates and resolves the plan with nothing else present.
Building, once RED starts: add coder, tester, traceability, security; add htmx and design for a web UI; add interlocking once trains have a runtime.
Instrumenting: add telemetry. Coordinating durable multi-agent work: add flow (governs durable seats, tasks and threads), only after the Flow companion is installed locally.

traceability joins with building: it judges plan-to-tests-and-source links, so before tests exist it only reports every acceptance untested; from then on it also catches a plan change that orphans a test.
security joins with the first code, not at release: a secret committed during GREEN stays in history.
Migrate a legacy explicit delivery/workflow profile by replacing it one-for-one with flow in the same list; that is not a loosening.
Read the selected profile's registry (conventions/_profiles/<profile>.yaml) instead of the complete graph.
avoid: Writing anything to profiles: other than the list the user chose.
Swapping or removing profiles at the next stage: presets accumulate; removing one loosens the gate.
A later preset for architecture, metrics, runtime, design or responsive detectors: coder already bundles them.
Adding flow by default or to a default profile list; it is optional.
unless: Any profile may be run by name to preview its report (atdd-bun coder) without touching profiles:; only profiles: decides what the repository is governed by.
why: A goal is easier to name than a profile; presets map the user's work to the profiles that judge it, in the order the work creates what they check.
evidence: Transcript shows the agent asked which work the user is doing and recommended the matching preset when the stage's preset was missing.
Diff of atdd-bun.yaml profiles: equals the list the user chose and is a superset of the previous list (except a one-for-one legacy delivery/workflow -> flow replacement).
flow appears in profiles: only when the Flow companion is installed locally.
verifier_detail: No automated detector (implementation.type: none): which work a user is doing cannot be validated from the repository; compliance is reviewed from transcript and config diff.

Presets (term 'presets'): planning=[planner]; building=[coder, tester, traceability, security]; instrumenting=[telemetry]; coordinating=[flow]. Conditional additions: docs (planning, when the repository keeps documentation under docs/), htmx and design (building, web UI), interlocking (building, once trains have a runtime).

Profile registries (term 'profile_registries') are deterministic, profile-scoped projections of detector manifests, convention paths and direct relationship edges: architecture=conventions/_profiles/architecture.yaml, coder=conventions/_profiles/coder.yaml, design=conventions/_profiles/design.yaml, docs=conventions/_profiles/docs.yaml, htmx=conventions/_profiles/htmx.yaml, interlocking=conventions/_profiles/interlocking.yaml, metrics=conventions/_profiles/metrics.yaml, planner=conventions/_profiles/planner.yaml, runtime=conventions/_profiles/runtime.yaml, security=conventions/_profiles/security.yaml, telemetry=conventions/_profiles/telemetry.yaml, tester=conventions/_profiles/tester.yaml, topology=conventions/_profiles/topology.yaml, traceability=conventions/_profiles/traceability.yaml, flow=conventions/_profiles/flow.yaml.

flow governs durable seats, tasks and threads only when the repository has the locally installed Flow companion; a legacy delivery or workflow profile replaced one-for-one by flow is not counted as a removal/loosening.
Writes to profiles: in atdd-bun.yaml must contain exactly the user-chosen list (the user decides; the agent writes only what they choose).
audit: Source kind: policy (source comment: 'A policy, not a rule: which work a user is doing cannot be validated from the repository').
Original name: The agent proposes the profiles the work at hand needs, one preset at a time

splitSuggestion.then: When changing profiles:, keep every previously active profile; only add (a one-for-one legacy delivery/workflow -> flow replacement is allowed).

additions.text: 'Presets accumulate, never swap' (atdd-bun.profiles.presets-accumulate) is an independently testable obligation; kept here as avoid[1], prefer[7] and verifier_detail[3], and could become a separate convention. The write-the-chosen-list step stays in this rule as prefer[0] (the follow-through of the proposal) with avoid[0] as its guard.
Activation facts, fires/doesNotFire examples and evidence items were derived from the statement and fix_hint.
additions.justification: Schema requires observable activation and verifier evidence; no new obligations introduced.

additions.text: Coder-facing text exceeds ~1,000 characters because the preset mapping, the write step and per-profile timing reasons (traceability scope, security timing, flow scope) are decision-relevant for the agent configuring profiles.
